insight.headline: GraphQL Admin API Error
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to handle the new error response. They should also review their metafield configurations to ensure they are set up correctly for filtering. This change may break existing queries, so thorough testing is recommended. The `metafield` argument in the `filter` field of the `query` type will now throw an error if the metafield is not configured for filtering.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice more accurate results from GraphQL queries, but they should not notice any significant changes to the functionality of their Shopify stores.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the reliability and accuracy of the GraphQL Admin API, reducing the likelihood of incorrect results and making it easier for developers to debug their queries.
insight.code_example: query { products(filter: { metafield: { key: "my_metafield", value: "my_value" } }) { edges { node { title } } } }

updates.title: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers
updates.summary: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API. This feature is available in POS UI Extensions 2026-07.

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Apps can now subscribe to events for various topics, including metafield changes, using the Events API.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, making it easier to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Shopify now provides full-stack capabilities to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview is now available, providing early access to a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.5.2, fixing a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen package has been updated to version 13.0.2, adding non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags to hydrogen link.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include a new requirement for unique app names, aiming to reduce merchant confusion.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API now supports the @inContext directive with an optional channelId argument, allowing for channel-specific context in queries.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: New fields have been added to the ExchangeLineItem type, including productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance POS UI extensions and GraphQL Admin API error handling

themes.title: POS UI Extensions
themes.detail: The new Printing API (shopify.printing) in POS UI Extensions 2026-07 enables extensions to discover and print directly to hardware receipt printers using getPrinters(). This update streamlines the printing process for merchants. Developers can leverage this API to build more integrated and efficient POS experiences.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Improvements
themes.detail: Starting in API version 2026-10, the GraphQL Admin API will return errors for invalid metafield queries, ensuring more accurate and reliable results. This change affects how developers handle metafield queries, promoting better error handling and debugging practices.
